Elena / Tom —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier this week. We'd like to lock in the Q2 boardroom-style QBR + demo for Veridian so we can:
- Walk the exec sponsor (VP/CRO) through the one-page ROI slide + top-level latency/cost callouts
- Run a 25–30 minute demo (production-like prompts) with a brief architecture review for your engineers
- Validate security/compliance posture and data handling approach with your InfoSec contacts

Proposed exec windows (PT):
- Tue May 10, 10:00–11:00
- Mon May 17, 10:00–11:00 (preferred on our side)

Two asks from your side before we finalize:
1) Who will be the executive sponsor that we should list on the invite? (VP-level preferred)
2) Please loop in your security / procurement contacts so we can pre-send the limited extracts and a short checklist for the InfoSec review.

I've attached a draft agenda (veridian-qbr-agenda.pdf). If May 17 works, we'll schedule a 45–60 minute slot: 30 demo + 15 exec Q/A, and a separate 60-minute technical deep-dive the day prior for your engineering/security team.

Thanks — happy to adjust timing.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

Appreciate the agenda. Quick answers:

- Security lead: Priya Reddy (priya.reddy@veridianbank.com) — I copied her below.
- Procurement: Ameet Singh (ameet.singh@veridianbank.com) handles our PO and contracting; copying him and procurement alias.

A couple of notes from our side:
- For the demo please redact any PHI/PII and if you have a sanitized dataset or a replay mode that would be ideal. Our InfoSec will want to review a small set of logs and the data flow (how KV cache and prefix caching are handled).
- Procurement prefers to see a sample SOW and standard PO terms before we lock a boardroom slot — can that be shared this week?

If you think May 17 is the right day, lock that and we'll aim to have Priya and Ameet at the technical & procurement touchpoints.
